1067291: The application at a certain subdomain was vulnerable to an unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) attack via CVE-2017-1000486 in primefaces 5.3. This allowed an attacker to execute code on the server as the unix `tomcat` user. The suggested mitigation was to update primefaces.
1067443: A vulnerability was discovered in Shopify's Screenshot Service that allowed an attacker to perform a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attack and leak the X-ABS-App-Token. This could potentially lead to further vulnerabilities. The vulnerability was caused by a lack of input validation in the screenshot service.
1067533: A rate limit bypass vulnerability was discovered on a website that allowed an attacker to reset the request limits by adding a specific header to the request. This vulnerability could be exploited to brute force login panels, send unlimited email notifications to victims, and bypass OTP codes.
1067547: Unauthenticated access to the webmail at maildev.happytools.dev allowed for the compromise of the WordPress site api.happytools.dev, potentially leading to unauthorized control and the ability to upload malicious scripts or backdoors.
1067809: The vulnerability allows for cookie poisoning, leading to denial-of-service and privacy violations.
1067824: A database error was displayed to users when entering a long guest name while sharing a file to a guest with editing permissions in richdocuments, resulting in sensitive information disclosure. 1068153: A cross-site leak vulnerability was discovered in Slack that allowed an attacker to de-anonymize members of their team from another origin. 1069039: GPS metadata was preserved when converting HEIF/HEIC files to PNG on Reddit.com, exposing the GPS locations of users who uploaded these files. 1069105: Two instances within VMware were vulnerable to remote file inclusion, allowing an attacker to view sensitive files on the server hosting the content and potentially execute remote code. 1069189: A security vulnerability was discovered in Grinch-Networks, which allowed attackers to access sensitive information and take down the network. The vulnerability was exploited through various means, including SQL injection, brute-forcing, and exploiting weak passwords. The impact of the vulnerability was significant.
1069392: The vulnerability allowed an attacker with access to a user's password to remain logged in to the user's account even after the password was changed, as the application failed to invalidate other active sessions. This could potentially lead to unauthorized access to the user's account. The recommended mitigation was to prompt users to close all active sessions after changing their password.
1069487: The Node.js debugger (--inspect option) was vulnerable to DNS rebinding attacks due to an excessive whitelist that included "localhost6". An attacker could bypass the protection by controlling the victim's DNS server or spoofing its responses, allowing them to gain access to the debugger and potentially execute remote code.
1069527: A reflected XSS vulnerability was found on mtnhottseat.mtn.com.gh, specifically on the parameters injectable in /api/v2/subscribe/. An attacker could inject malicious JavaScript code that would have access to cookies and local storage, potentially allowing them to impersonate a user. 1069528: A reflected XSS vulnerability was found on gamesclub.mtn.com.g, specifically on the /header.aspx parameter. An attacker could inject malicious code into the parameter, which would execute when the page is loaded by a victim. This could allow the attacker to steal session cookies and impersonate the victim, as well as modify the contents of the page.
1069531: A Blind SQL Injection vulnerability was found on a website's login page, allowing an attacker to bypass authentication and authorization mechanisms and potentially retrieve, modify, or delete data from the database. 1069561: A SQL injection vulnerability was found on intensedebate.com, allowing an attacker to bypass authentication and authorization mechanisms, retrieve database contents, and modify or delete records. The vulnerability could also be used to execute OS commands.
1070081: A vulnerability was discovered that allowed attackers to access users' private notes without permission. 1070247: An arbitrary file write vulnerability was discovered in Phabricator's Diffusion API. Depending on the server configuration, this could result in remote code execution.
1070510: A vulnerability was discovered in Streamlabs that allowed an attacker to manipulate the response of the API endpoint responsible for checking whether a user has a prime subscription or not. The impact of this vulnerability was that attackers could exploit it to get free access to prime features and free items at no cost.
1070532: A Remote Code Execution vulnerability was found in Apache Struts2 when performing file upload based on Jakarta Multipart parser, allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the target system by sending a malicious Content-Type value. 1070835: CS:GO was vulnerable to a critical out-of-bounds read vulnerability that allowed an attacker to execute arbitrary code on any client that connects to a malicious server. 1071832: A vulnerability was found in the True Image client that allowed a non-admin user to execute commands to force an MSI file to "repair" the program. 1071918: Improper session management between Streamlabs' main website and its support portal allowed shared-access users with moderator or administrator roles to access and modify the support tickets and profile of the parent user, which they should not have been able to do.
1072277: A host header injection vulnerability was found in oslo.io that allowed an attacker to inject a malicious host header using the X-Forwarded-Host header, leading to email spoofing and potential account theft.
1072616: A stored XSS vulnerability was found on a website due to unsafe input being registered on the account name and last name fields, allowing an attacker to execute JavaScript on behalf of the victim. The issue was resolved by sanitizing the input on the affected fields.
1072893: Sensitive information, such as the parent user's email and JWT token, could be disclosed to shared access users via the Streamlabs platform API due to improper access control on the API endpoint. 1073114: Two subdomains at readfu.com were taken over via Heroku services and normal domain buy, potentially allowing for various malicious activities such as malware, phishing, XSS, authentication bypass, and open redirects. The suggested fix was to remove the subdomains' DNS.
1073202: Snapcraft before version 4.4.4 was vulnerable to remote code execution due to library inclusion from the current working directory. Attackers could gain remote code execution in almost any application that was installed with snapcraft, when run in an attacker controlled directory. This could be as simple as running an application in a cloned git repository. The vulnerability was fixed by Snapcraft, but many applications were still vulnerable until regenerated correctly.
1073363: An index out of bounds vulnerability was discovered in the gogo/protobuf code generator used in Kubernetes v1.20.2 and other APIs. The vulnerability could allow attackers to crash nodes that use the affected protobuf code. The issue was caused by a lack of checks when skipping certain bytes, which could cause an overflow and negative value. A patch has been released, and it is recommended to regenerate all existing protobuf code or apply the patch manually.
1073420: Sensitive user data, including email addresses and personally identifiable information (PII), was exposed due to an insecure API endpoint on apps.topcoder.com/forums/. Attackers could obtain this data by manipulating the "uid" parameter in a POST request to fast.trychameleon.com.
1073565: An open redirect vulnerability was discovered on the subdomains flightschool.twitter.com and takeflight.twitter.com. This vulnerability allowed attackers to craft URLs that could redirect users to a site of their choosing, potentially leading to phishing scams.
1074047: A misconfigured OAuth in Badoo allowed attackers to register using an unregistered victim's email address and bypass the verification process when the victim logs in using OAuth, enabling the attacker to log in using the victim's password. The vulnerability was fixed by either preventing users from entering with OAuth when there is already another account created with the same email or asking the user to change the password if someone else has already created an account.
1074136: Sensitive personal information of more than 100 officers was leaked due to a bypass of a fix on a website. An attacker was able to access the information by using a Google Dork and accessing the cached content. The suggested mitigation actions include taking down the website and contacting Google to remove the cached content.
1074613: The DuckDuckGo mobile app was vulnerable to cache corruption due to a specially crafted URL that contained encoded quotation marks. This could cause the app to crash and require reinstallation to resolve the issue. The vulnerability was present in the app's latest release and affected Android 8.1 and 9.
1076047: A bypass vulnerability was discovered in the creation of Plug-Ins at a certain website, allowing an attacker to create a large number of Plug-Ins that could occupy memory and charge the application. 1077022: The Brave Browser Tor Window leaked users' real IP addresses and requested domain names to external DNS servers, undermining user anonymity. DNS requests were sent directly without using the Tor proxy.
1077136: It was possible to perform a Denial of Service attack on Slack via hyperlinks in posts. 1078002: A vulnerability was discovered in Nextcloud Desktop Client that allowed for remote code execution via malicious URI schemes. 1080437: The Bumble API endpoint at `https://am1.bumble.com/mwebapi.phtml?SERVER_OPEN_CHAT` exposed the read status of individual messages within all chats, potentially violating the privacy of the user on the other end. 1081211: The contact form on nextcloud.com allowed control characters in the "Subject Name" field, which could be exploited by an attacker to hijack emails or redirect users to a website containing malware. 1081406: An open redirect vulnerability was present in the ck.php and lg.php delivery scripts of Revive Adserver, allowing attackers to redirect users to malicious URLs via certain parameters. This could result in users being redirected to a malicious website without their knowledge or consent.
1081656: An HTML injection vulnerability was found on a website's search parameter, allowing an attacker to inject malicious code into the website. The vulnerability was fixed by the website's team.
1081750: A vulnerability was identified in the marketplace panel on enablement.informatica.com, allowing unauthorized access to the admin panel with any username and password. 1081994: A stored XSS vulnerability was found at a military website, allowing an attacker to upload a file containing malicious JavaScript code through a form and trigger XSS, potentially leading to cookie theft or website defacement.
1082521: A vulnerability was found that allowed for the disclosure of the server path where PHP files were hosted. 1082847: A vulnerability was discovered in the code of app.grammarly.com that allowed an attacker to inject a configuration override using a non-validated query parameter. 1082891: A vulnerability was found in the system where duplicate entry of email led to a 500 server error, which disclosed the SQL database table information. The issue was caused by the lack of validation to detect the re-registration of the same email ID after it was soft-deleted. Additionally, debug was enabled while pushing codes to production, which showed data only needed for internal use.
1083231: A reflected XSS vulnerability was discovered on `/admin/userlog-index.php` in Revive-Adserver version `revive-adserver-5.1.0`. 1083376: A reflected XSS vulnerability was found on `/admin/stats.php` in Revive-Adserver version `revive-adserver-5.1.0`. 1083923: A misconfiguration in the sharing products with mail feature allowed users to send emails from accounts that did not belong to them, potentially enabling phishing attacks. The vulnerability was corrected by requiring users to choose an email address to send from.
1084342: A buffer overflow vulnerability was discovered in PyCArg_repr in _ctypes/callproc.c for Python 3.x to 3.9.1, which could allow remote code execution in certain Python applications that accept floating-point numbers as untrusted input. 1085079: An unlimited amount of newsletter subscriptions could be made due to a business logic error, allowing an attacker to send bulk emails and inject infected XSS, potentially capturing user session tokens.
1085336: A vulnerability was discovered in Snapchat that allowed a malicious actor to perform a CSRF attack by sending a specially crafted link to a victim. 1085743: An IDOR vulnerability existed in the demo.openmage.org application that allowed an attacker to add a new address on their account by editing the address of another user. 1085782: An IDOR vulnerability in a healthcare website allowed non-medical users to view the shot records of people who were not their sponsors. 1086108: Arbitrary content could be served on a customer's domain through existing DNS records already configured to work with Shopify wholesale due to a missing domain format check in Shopify's wholesale functionality. 1086752: The forgot password page in OpenMage was vulnerable to CSRF attacks, allowing an attacker to change a user's password without their knowledge or consent. This could lead to unauthorized access to the user's account.
1086781: Project visibility on GitLab could be changed to a restricted option even if an administrator had restricted it, by making a PUT request to the API route. 1087061: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability existed on GitLab Wiki pages due to unsanitized input. 1087188: A race condition vulnerability allowed users to obtain more free trials on hosted.weblate.org, which resulted in getting more strings and languages limit than the allowed limit. The vulnerability was caused by the lack of IP-based rate limit and allowing multiple requests for trial.
1087382: A vulnerability was identified in the mobile application of an online store platform that allowed an unauthorized user to delete or sell a store without authentication. 1087489: A GitHub Personal Access Token belonging to a Shopify employee was found in a public MacOS app, which granted read and write access to all of Shopify's private GitHub repositories. 1088966: A vulnerability existed in HackerOne's Sandbox Program that allowed an attacker to invite a team member to a new program in the sandbox, despite the description stating that it was not possible. This could have potentially allowed unauthorized access to the sandbox program.
1089116: An email enumeration vulnerability was discovered in Rocket.Chat up to version 3.10.5. The vulnerability was mitigated by using general messages when a user exists in the system and when a user doesn't exist in the system.
1089978: It was possible to manipulate the payment request in Shopify's Point of Sale (PoS) system to overcharge customers and send money from the store to the customer. The impact of this vulnerability was the potential manipulation of customer and store funds without their knowledge or consent.
1090838: A Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability was found in a web application, which allowed an attacker to send requests on behalf of a victim without their knowledge or consent. 1091165: The website at http://macademy.mtnonline.com was vulnerable to a Cross-site Scripting (XSS) attack, which allowed an attacker to inject malicious JavaScript into the webpage and potentially hijack authenticated sessions or modify the page's layout and functionality. 1091209: A CSRF vulnerability was found in the Wholesale application that allowed an attacker to generate an invitation token for a user and move that user to "invited" status without their consent. This could potentially lead to unauthorized access to the user's account.
1091303: A low privilege user in Shopify POS was able to read POS PINs via GraphQL and elevate their privilege by using the Manager PIN, allowing them to perform actions they should not have been able to do.
1091380: Financial data for services in a partner's organization was accessible by staff members with no permission to view financials. This vulnerability allowed unauthorized access to sensitive financial information.
1091957: A vulnerability was discovered on demo.openmage.org that allowed for very long names to be used during registration and profile updates. 1092230: A vulnerability was discovered in the FogBugz import code used by GitLab that allowed for a full GET-based SSRF attack against gitlab.com. 1092574: The `IPS\cms\modules\front\pages\_builder::previewBlock()` method in IPS Community Suite allowed arbitrary content to be passed to the `IPS\_Theme::runProcessFunction()` method, which could be exploited to inject and execute arbitrary PHP code. 1092678: A self-stored XSS vulnerability was discovered in a web application that allowed users to set a username between 8-20 alphanumeric characters. An attacker could manipulate the username field using inspect element and insert a malicious payload resulting in successful execution of JavaScript. Additionally, a login CSRF vulnerability was present that could allow an attacker to force the victim into the attacker's account. The suggested mitigation is to sanitize input.
1092859: Dangling DNS servers were found in the KOPS project's Route53 configuration, which referenced domains that were not registered. Additionally, any PayPal subscriptions or other payment providers previously connected to the subdomain could be re-claimed and billed by a malicious actor.
1093908: An insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability was discovered in a subdomain of a highly protected encryption chat app. The vulnerability leaked only usernames, which could be used to access the login authentication of the app's panel. The suggested mitigation was to use HTTP Authorization header or restrict access to the affected directory.
1094063: A security vulnerability in the Mail app of Nextcloud allowed an attacker to take over a mail account due to missing validation of account id. 1094151: An API key for Rockset was leaked on Github due to being visible in an old commit. The key was not revoked at the time of discovery.
1094276: A reflected XSS vulnerability was discovered in the URI path parameter of a website, allowing an attacker to execute JavaScript on behalf of the victim. The vulnerability was reported to the security team and a suggested mitigation action was to sanitize the URI path parameter.
1095612: The Validating Admission webhook for Node Objects in Kubernetes v1.19.x passed oldObject fields incorrectly on AdmissionReview.Request, potentially allowing users to bypass validating admission to update node labels, taints, and other fields. 1095645: The WordPress core Media Library was vulnerable to an authenticated XXE attack when running on PHP 8. The vulnerability was caused by relying on the `LIBXML_NOENT` flag, which explicitly activates entity substitution.
1095765: A reflected XSS vulnerability was found in a system's `██████████` parameter, which was not properly escaped for URL encoded values. Attackers could execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of the attacked website and user, potentially leading to session cookie theft, requests in the victim's name, or phishing attacks. The suggested mitigation is to sanitize the input on the affected parameter.
1095830: A vulnerability was discovered in CRXDE Lite/CRX in AEM that allowed unauthenticated users to access sensitive information, potentially leading to PII exposure. The vulnerability was found on a specific system host and could be exploited by executing a query and accessing a specific endpoint.
1096560: Arbitrary images, descriptions, and titles could be added to other people's issues on getrevue.co via IDOR, allowing attackers to hijack other people's issues.
1096609: The website themes.shopify.com was vulnerable to web cache poisoning via HOST header, which could lead to a denial of service attack. An attacker could poison the cache with an HTTP header Host header with an arbitrary PORT that is not opened, causing many images, CSS, and links to not load, resulting in a denial of service.
1097217: A reflected XSS vulnerability was found on `/admin/stats.php` in Revive-Adserver version `revive-adserver-5.1.1`. This could lead to cookie theft or redirection to malicious websites.
1097979: A reflected XSS vulnerability was found on `/admin/campaign-zone-zones.php` in Revive-Adserver version `revive-adserver-5.1.1`. An attacker could execute malicious code, such as stealing user cookies or redirecting users to a malicious website.
1098793: A vulnerability was discovered in Asciidoctor that could allow for arbitrary file read/write in Asciidoctor-kroki. The vulnerability could be exploited by using a counter to bypass Gitlab's attempt to disable kroki-plantuml-include. An attacker could use this vulnerability to read or write files on the server, potentially leading to RCE.
1098948: A Host Header Injection vulnerability was found during security testing on a main domain. An attacker could manipulate the Host header to cause unexpected behavior in the web application. 1101882: Credentials could be leaked through the referrer header when using the `--referer ';auto'` feature in curl. This could result in unwanted disclosure of credentials in third-party web server logs. A patch has been released to fix the vulnerability.
1102018: A Stored XSS vulnerability was found in the Concrete5 CMS version 8.5.4 due to lack of user supplied data filtration in the `description` parameter of the `/index.php/ccm/calendar/dialogs/event/add/save` scenario. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by performing a CSRF attack using a specially crafted web page, potentially leading to the disclosure of sensitive information or unauthorized actions on behalf of the user.
1102067: A path traversal vulnerability was discovered in Concrete5 CMS version 8.5.4. This would lead to the execution of the injected malicious code. As a result, the attacker could run arbitrary system commands and obtain sensitive information.
1102365: The "UpdateSound" API in Dubsmash was vulnerable to IDOR, allowing an attacker to modify the titles of other users' soundtracks by changing the UUID parameter in the request. This could potentially lead to malicious titles being assigned to the victim's soundtracks.
1102591: A Blind SQL Injection vulnerability was discovered in a domain, allowing an attacker to gain access and control over the backend database server. The vulnerability was exploited using a specially crafted POST input. No information was provided regarding affected products or suggested mitigation actions.
1103033: A reflected XSS vulnerability was found on a website, allowing an attacker to steal user information by injecting malicious code into a trusted website. 1171403: A reflected XSS vulnerability was discovered that required user interaction. The payload was suspicious due to its reflection in the page. 1172205: Insufficient session expiration was identified in the com.shopify.ping android app, allowing the authentication token to remain valid even after the user logs out. This could allow an attacker to recover a fully functional session and access sensitive information.
1172857: A vulnerability was found in libcurl's implementation of SCHANNEL that allowed the last configured cipher list to override the configuration used by other connections, potentially leading to insecure cipher configuration being used where secure configuration was expected. 1173040: A stored XSS vulnerability was found on hackerone.com via custom fields. 1173153: A cache poisoning Denial of Service (DoS) vulnerability was discovered on downloads.exodus.com, which hosts files for download by Exodus users. 1173436: The default settings of Nextcloud allowed the federated cloud id of every user to be leaked to the lookup server, even if none of the fields were set to 'published'. This vulnerability could potentially expose a significant portion of Nextcloud users to the lookup server.
1173593: A reflected XSS vulnerability was found in the /█████ component of the www.████████ site via the █████████ parameter, allowing attackers to execute malicious code in the victim's browser. The vulnerability was assigned CVE-2017-14651 and a suggested mitigation is available.
1173598: A vulnerability existed that allowed an attacker to list and download every file in two S3 buckets. 1173684: The `index.php/apps/files_sharing/shareinfo` endpoint in Nextcloud was not properly protected, allowing attackers to enumerate available tokens and perform denial of service attacks by sending a lot of valid requests that could lead to a significant number of queries and memory usage on the system. 1174185: The Telerik UI component is vulnerable to remote code execution via insecure deserialization, allowing an attacker to upload arbitrary files and execute code on the underlying system. 1174527: The vulnerability allowed an administrator to change the account owner access token, which could lead to control of the stream and revocation of widgets used by streamers. The vulnerability was caused by a flaw in the API Access Token refresh feature.
1175980: An improper access control vulnerability was found in the Transportation Management Services Solution (TMSS) 2.0 website, which allowed unauthenticated users to access an endpoint that exposed the personal data of all registered users, including email addresses, phone numbers, full names, and secret questions. 1177287: A password reset token leak was identified in the application, where the referrer token was being leaked to third-party sites, potentially allowing malicious users to use the token and reset the passwords of the victim. 1178239: An open protocol redirection vulnerability was discovered on streamlabs.com that allowed a session takeover by a malicious app. The vulnerability was caused by the endpoint `streamlabs.com/global/identity?popup=1&r=protocol://merch.streamlabs.com` that redirected any authenticated user to an arbitrary protocol, which could be intercepted by a malicious app to steal the access token and allow session takeover on multiple streamlabs domains. 1178337: Improper handling of untypical characters in domain names in node's `dns` library could lead to Domain Hijacking and injection vulnerabilities in applications using the library. 1178562: A vulnerability existed in the `net/imap` library in Ruby versions prior to 2.3.0. 1179193: The www2.growasyouplan.com subdomain pointed to an AWS EC2 instance that no longer existed, allowing an attacker to take control of the IP address and serve arbitrary/malicious content to any customers or servers pointing to the domain. 1179241: A private program disclosure vulnerability was discovered where a user who was not invited to a private program received a notification alert in their H1 account notification box indicating that the private program had posted a new message. 1180252: A buffer overrun vulnerability was discovered in the SteamWorks SDK's SILK voice decoder function, which is used by many services including Steam and most Source engine titles. 1180380: A vulnerability existed in libcurl's TLS session caching mechanism due to a use-after-free issue. 1180697: The subdomain v.zego.com pointed to an AWS EC2 instance that no longer existed, allowing an attacker to take control of the IP address and serve arbitrary/malicious content to any customers or servers pointing to the domain. 1181253: The registration process of https://tams.preprod.gsa.gov was vulnerable to e-mail verification bypass through interception and modification of response status, allowing an attacker to bypass the verification process and continue with the registration process.
1181946: A vulnerability was discovered on hackerone.com that allowed an attacker to make static files inaccessible through a cache poisoning attack. 1182016: A vulnerability was found where email verification could be bypassed during sign up, allowing accounts to be created with email addresses not belonging to the user. This impacted the integrity of the signup process.
1182465: An IDOR vulnerability was found on the www.acronis.com API, which allowed an attacker to steal private business user information, such as company name, user name, surname, telephone number, etc. by accessing a specific endpoint with a guessable token value.
1182864: The fr1.vpn.zomans.com subdomain pointed to an AWS EC2 instance that no longer existed, allowing an attacker to take control of the IP address and serve arbitrary/malicious content to customers or servers pointing to the domain. 1183263: A web cache poisoning vulnerability was discovered on a web application that uses a web cache to serve pages more efficiently. 1183296: The main domain of the website was vulnerable to subdomain takeover due to an unclaimed CNAME record pointing to Wix.com. 1183601: A cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) misconfiguration vulnerability was discovered that allowed attackers to steal user information from a website. 1184644: A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability was found on a website, allowing for client-side attacks. Exploitation was possible despite some difficulty due to the WAF blocking some vectors. A proof of concept was provided showing an alert popup. The affected website was www.██████████.
1185028: Multiple subdomains of the Kaspersky domain were vulnerable to a web cache deception attack, potentially allowing an attacker to steal sensitive information of website users. The issue was fixed by changing caching settings. No action is required from users.
1186701: No DMARC and DNS records were found on mcuboot.com, allowing an attacker to spoof any mcuboot.com email address and potentially appear as a high-profile individual or company.
1187018: The program's domain name in HackerOne was incorrect and redirected to Wix.com, which could have allowed an attacker to create a fake website with the same name and potentially steal login data from researchers who clicked on the link.
1187820: A Reflected XSS vulnerability was discovered on the `/admin/stats.php` page of the Revive Adserver application. 1188128: A vulnerability existed in the Python "urllib" library that allowed an attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) attack on a client requesting an HTTP/HTTPS/FTP service controlled by the attacker. 1189162: The public key of a user's end-to-end encryption was not properly verified on Desktop and Android, allowing an attacker with access to the server to replace the public key with their own and intercept the user's encrypted data. 1189168: End-to-end encryption keys and mnemonic were not cleared from an Android device after a user removed their account from a server, allowing an attacker who obtains the device to access all encrypted files and data.
1189174: An attacker could exploit a vulnerability in the end-to-end encryption folder locking feature of Nextcloud, allowing them to lock all file IDs and prevent users from interacting with their encrypted data. 1189367: A vulnerability was found in www.evernote.com that allowed for full read SSRF, which could leak AWS metadata and enable local file inclusion. 1192144: The Nextcloud endpoint used to mount public links was not properly protected, allowing attackers to potentially brute force share tokens. Although the impact was low, the vulnerability needed to be fixed.
1192460: A deactivated user was able to access information through the API via GraphQL, which is not enforced by the rules for deactivated users. The vulnerability was fixed in GitLab 13.11.2.
1192470: The server public key verification is not implemented in the clients, allowing a compromised server to send different public keys to each client, compromising the end-to-end encryption.
1193062: An external user with maintainer privileges on a project in GitLab was able to create a project token that was connected to a bot with internal access, allowing the user to access all internal projects, including source code, and create issues on internal projects. This could lead to severe information disclosure and unauthorized access.
1193321: Scoped apptokens in Nextcloud could be changed by the same apptoken, allowing an attacker to gain full access to all user data. 1193641: GlassWire version 2.1.167 had an arbitrary code execution vulnerability where it attempted to load Wtsapi32.dll.dll from the user's PATH without checking if the file was signed.
1194301: A reflected XSS vulnerability was found in a hidden input on the Topcoder website's community stories section. An attacker could inject their own code into the website through the input, potentially leading users to malicious websites or displaying false information.
1194606: A vulnerability was discovered in Nextcloud's Virtual Data Room feature, which allows users to view and modify documents in a watermark-protected way while disabling downloads and other apps using File Access Control. 1195325: The default "Administrator for the default organization" credentials were used on a misconfigured Department of Defense website, allowing a potential attacker to access the login page and potentially gain unauthorized access. 1195568: The ransomware protection app was found to be missing some common extensions, indicating that it was not regularly updated and maintained. This could potentially put users at risk of ransomware attacks.
1196945: A reflected XSS vulnerability was discovered on a URL, allowing an attacker to steal cookies or perform actions on behalf of the user. The vulnerability was mitigated by properly sanitizing the affected URL parameter.
1196958: A clipboard DOM-based XSS vulnerability existed on several Markdown text fields in GitLab. 1196976: An IDOR vulnerability existed in the attachment upload feature of a certain section of the system, allowing an attacker to upload attachments to other users' sections if they had not uploaded any attachments themselves. 1196989: A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability was discovered at a certain URL, which could allow attackers to execute malicious scripts on the victim's browser. 1197013: The subdomain █████.jitsi.net pointed to an AWS EC2 instance that no longer existed, allowing an attacker to take control of the IP address and serve arbitrary/malicious content on the domain. 1198434: A cache poisoning vulnerability was discovered that allowed an attacker to store an incorrect port number in the cache server, leading to a denial of service (DoS) attack on the affected domain. The vulnerability could be exploited by an attacker using an intruder to update the cache server at regular intervals, causing the domain to go down. The suggested mitigation is to configure the cache server to not store the host header.
1198439: A vulnerability was found where the domain app.upchieve.org did not have a valid SPF record, which allowed for email spoofing attacks. This could lead to phishing and spam campaigns, potentially causing damage to the company's reputation and putting user data at risk. The issue was reported and acknowledged by the company.
1198517: A stored XSS vulnerability was discovered in GitLab's custom emoji feature. The vulnerability was caused by insufficient escaping of the `src` value in the `emoji_image_tag` function. 1198907: A clickjacking vulnerability was found on the profile page of a website, allowing an attacker to use iFrame options to remotely connect to the website and craft their own website to lead to unauthorized changes if the user was logged in. 1199527: A Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) misconfiguration vulnerability was discovered that could allow attackers to access sensitive information. 1200583: An exposed Prometheus dashboard was discovered, allowing access to internal metrics of QA systems. The endpoint was publicly accessible at prometheus.qa.r3.com.
1200700: A user deletion vulnerability was found in Nextcloud where new users could potentially access data of other users that left the system if they were assigned the same user ID. 1200810: An admin audit vulnerability was discovered where unsetting the expiration date of a shared file was not properly logged, resulting in incomplete audit logs. This could potentially impact the ability to track actions and access to files.
1201396: A session hijacking vulnerability was discovered on the website, which allowed an attacker to gain unauthorized access to a user's account by stealing or predicting a valid session token. 1202408: The add comment endpoint on redditgifts was improperly rate-limited, allowing potential attackers to post a large number of comments and overload the server. 1202590: Webauthn tokens were not removed from the server when a user was deleted, allowing a new user to be assigned the same ID and potentially allowing the old user to access the new user's data using their previously registered key/device.
1208453: Account takeover was possible through a CSRF vulnerability at 'Change Security Question/Answer' and 'Change Password' endpoints on https://autochoice.fas.gsa.gov. 1209681: An out-of-bound read vulnerability was discovered in libuv, which is used by Node.js. 1210043: All of the class codes on a educational website were enumerated by using a specific Google search query. This allowed unauthorized access to join classes without an invitation from teachers, potentially enabling disruption.
1210450: A 1-byte heap buffer overflow vulnerability was discovered in the DNS resolver of nginx versions 0.6.18 to 1.20.0. The issue has been fixed in nginx 1.21.0 and 1.20.1.
1210458: The serverinfo app did not have bruteforce protection on its endpoints and the custom tokens generated were weak, making it easy for attackers to obtain access. It was recommended to add bruteforce protection and a button in the UI to generate a long random string.
1210921: A reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability was found in the dailydeals.mtn.co.za website. The vulnerability was caused by the server reflecting user input without proper filtering.
1211094: A vulnerability was discovered in F5 BIG-IP Cookie that potentially revealed BigIP pool name, backend's IP address and port, and routed domain. 1211160: Node was vulnerable to local privilege escalation attacks on Windows platforms due to improper configuration of permissions in the installation directory. This allowed an attacker to perform two different escalation attacks: PATH and DLL hijacking. 1212067: A stored XSS vulnerability was discovered in GitLab that allowed arbitrary JavaScript to be run anywhere that markdown could be posted, such as issues and comments. 1212235: A reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability was found on dailydeals.mtn.co.za, which allowed an attacker to execute malicious code on a victim's browser by convincing them to visit a specially crafted URL. 1212337: The URL validation implemented by Khan Academy on the endpoint "continue" did not have any boundary checking to ignore domains starting with ".org". 1212822: A stored XSS vulnerability was discovered in Mermaid when viewing Markdown files on GitLab. This could lead to full account takeover without user interaction.
1212853: A broken link hijacking vulnerability was discovered in the Kubernetes CSI documentation website. Attackers could claim the endpoints of broken links and redirect users to their own repositories, potentially leading to the installation of malicious software.
1213175: A vulnerability existed in cURL that allowed files with incorrect cryptographic hashes to be saved to disk when using metalink with insecure protocols. 1213181: Credentials were leaked by cURL when compiled with `--with-libmetalink` and used with `--metalink` and `--user` options. 1213237: A vulnerability was discovered on RedditGifts.com that allowed an attacker to delete all 4.4 million private messages due to a missing permission check on a DELETE request. By sending a specific request with cookies, an attacker could delete any message on the platform.
1213765: A vulnerability existed in the Reddit Gold payment system that allowed users to modify the PayPal transaction ID and purchase a large coin pack for a smaller price. This could result in users not earning the money they deserved and could break the Reddit community's reward system.
1215251: A vulnerability in Nextcloud Mail allowed attackers to bypass the privacy filter and tracking pixel blocker by injecting images via CSS attributes, enabling them to track users who opened the email. 1215263: A vulnerability in Nextcloud Mail allowed an attacker to send a victim a file with a benign extension such as `.txt` or `.png` which, when downloaded, would be stored with a malicious extension such as `.bat` or `.docm`. 1216085: The CCC CTF website was vulnerable to XXE (XML External Entity) injection, which allowed an attacker to read arbitrary files on the server. 1216203: A reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability was found in the OAuth flow of Mattermost Server. A malicious link could trigger the XSS, potentially allowing an attacker to read messages or create a new administrator. The vulnerability was fixed by the Mattermost team.
1217114: The challenge involved vulnerabilities in an S3 bucket, XML External Entity (XXE) injection, and SQL injection. The SQL injection vulnerability allowed the attacker to extract the admin password by manipulating the packet size of ICMP packets.
1218680: An improper authorization vulnerability was found on the `/api/as/v1/credentials/` endpoint for the Dev Role User with Limited Engine Access in Elastic App Search. 1219011: The bulk endpoint "agree-on-going-public" action in HackerOne allowed a user to cancel the disclosure request of a previously disclosed report without proper validation, revealing the report's disclosure state for invite-only programs. 1219038: A cache poisoning vulnerability was discovered on updates.rockstargames.com due to an unkeyed header, `trailer`. 1220747: A vulnerability was discovered in HackerOne's payment system during a Hack Week project. 1223565: A flaw in the `Curl_ssl_config_matches` function in libcurl allowed for bad connection reuse due to flawed path name checks. 1223882: A vulnerability (CVE-2021-22925) was found in the TELNET stack of curl that allowed for the disclosure of uninitialized stack memory contents. 1224660: A SQL injection vulnerability was discovered and bypassed in a web application, allowing an attacker to execute malicious SQL statements and potentially retrieve, modify, or delete database records. 1225299: The Ping Identity's vulnerability submission form on HackerOne contained a broken link that could potentially be claimed and exploited by a malicious user to create a fake impersonation of the security page, leading to the misdirection of legitimate vulnerability reports.
1226891: The domain Reddit.ru was vulnerable to DNS hijacking via DNS provider Reg.ru, allowing a malicious attacker to control the content on the domain and create email addresses associated with it. 1234406: The Bumble dating app was vulnerable to a location tracking attack that allowed an attacker to determine the exact location of any user whose user ID they knew. 1234746: A vulnerability was discovered where a user was able to receive notifications about updates to a private program they were not a part of, potentially disclosing the private program handle. The issue was caused by incomplete fixes to a previous vulnerability.
1234760: A vulnerability (CVE-2021-22926) was found in libcurl's Secure Transport SSL backend, which failed to secure the `CURLOPT_SSLCERT` against current directory file overriding the keychain nickname specified. The impact of this vulnerability was limited to causing denial of service.
1235008: A vulnerability was discovered that allowed an attacker to hijack access to a Social Club account via a previously-linked Epic Games or Steam account. The issue has been addressed by requiring re-authentication when switching accounts in this context.
1237700: Improper input validation in SEMrush Projects allowed an attacker to set the name of a tag to null, causing a critical bug in the front-end.
